changelog:
v2.13.8 - NOOR gate

- New NOOR gate: after every unlock, Astaghfirullah three times before the phone is usable. Whole screen, takes every tap, three dots fill as you tap.
- Safety valves so you can never be trapped: auto-closes after 90 seconds, hold anywhere 4 seconds to release, Turn off gate button in the notification.
- Tools -> NOOR Gate shows today's count and a Preview gate button.
- Deep green and gold gradient with breathing light rings, drawn by hand so it cannot crash the way a Compose overlay can.
